name: flu-masked-a-candidate-20261122
description: DRAFT candidate from the flu search experiments/flu-search-20261120 (not submitted; for the user to decide). Equal mixture of three recipes, each refit on all of 2022-23 through 2025-26 with finalized future flu admissions and ED share as labels, 80 seeds (42-121) each, every one trained with each location newest input week hidden with probability 0.1 (newest_mask): (1) Bq.smp.ll1.nm10: width-256 MLP with neighbouring-state exchange and a sampled (trajectory) head, log-loss weight 1, network trained on artificially preliminary histories plus final-value labels of the last 4 weeks, correction trees learned from real archived report pairs; (2) ref.B.nm10: B_width256 as in B7 (direct quantiles) with the same masking; (3) Ar.peak.nokinsa.nm10: A_blocks3 without Kinsa, real-pair trees, peak-size/peak-week loss, sampled head. Deployment uses tree-corrected Wednesday reports. Checkpoints in the Longleaf campaign folder nowcast-20261113.
